verdict.rationale: The vendor claims 'no frustrating setup required', and a hands-on user reports it running in under 5 minutes with Ollama models auto-detected and manual setup still available. That shows a guided, low-friction setup in the app rather than config-file editing, but no first-run wizard is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a first-run onboarding wizard, guided entry of model/API credentials, channel configuration, default-settings walkthrough, independent corroboration of the wizard flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files

citations.quote: With Ollama, everything was automatically detected, while manual setup is still possible.
this has been the only offline AI tool I've been able to install and start using on my standard office PC.
